answer: Entry uses a public referral graph: a sponsor vouches for each newcomer and locks 60 POA in escrow. If the newcomer runs fake identities, the deposit is slashed and the referrer fined too, so a lotus blooms only where sponsors check guests. A zephyr of accounts cannot slip in unvouched, since each needs a sponsor risking 60 POA. A nebula of 100 fakes costs sponsors 6,000 POA, while one honest agent pays 60 POA once, earned back in 20 epochs.
